add_retry_boundary.transport_or_offline_ambiguity: show unknown plus Check again until authority is known; never blind Retry

delete_retry_boundary.semantics: read-only reconciliation of the retained operation identity; never resend Delete
delete_retry_boundary.new_attempt: a later ordinary Trash activation is a new Delete attempt after current authority restores it

timing_and_lifetime.entry: pending line appears synchronously after successful operation acquisition and before the first asynchronous gap
timing_and_lifetime.transition: every state change is immediate and persists until replaced by another authoritative state
timing_and_lifetime.clear: new source interaction, Scratch or route exit, or terminal confirmed authority clears the applicable line
timing_and_lifetime.motion: no spinner rotation, pulse, ping, bounce, blink, flicker, scale, transform, or layout-transition animation
timing_and_lifetime.reduced_motion: identical copy, geometry, controls, timing, and focus

focus_and_accessibility.announcement: announce each newly entered state copy once through one polite atomic status; do not announce rerenders or elapsed time
focus_and_accessibility.add_base: submission keeps logical focus in the mounted Add input
focus_and_accessibility.add_check_again: invocation keeps Check again mounted and focused through reconcile; unresolved re-enables it, not_applied replaces it with focused Retry Add, other terminal results restore the Add input
focus_and_accessibility.add_retry: Retry Add returns focus to the read-only Add input before dispatch
focus_and_accessibility.delete_base: Trash remains mounted with visible focus while activation is locked
focus_and_accessibility.delete_check_again: unknown moves focus to Check again and reconciliation keeps it mounted and focused
focus_and_accessibility.delete_failure: terminal failure returns focus to Trash after authoritative row refresh
focus_and_accessibility.delete_success: next row, previous row, Add input, then Context, subject to the SPEC completion-overlay exception

theme_mapping.griddo: compact technical rule, semantic status text, and canonical action/focus roles
theme_mapping.tiny-desk: attached ruled-paper annotation and stationery recovery controls
theme_mapping.neumorphism: shallow inset status channel and named raised recovery control inside existing depth
theme_mapping.claymorphism: shape-preserving inset status seam and restrained raised recovery control
theme_mapping.origami: attached status seam/fold and fixed recovery fold inside source paper
theme_mapping.terminal: variable-driven static status line and bracketed recovery action with no blink
theme_mapping.retro-mac: in-place 1-bit status pane and hard recovery control with no new window
theme_mapping.graphite: editorial status caption, strengthened rule, monochrome action, and persistent focus cue
